_**Operating Manual For Spaceship Earth**_ is a short book by [R. Buckminster Fuller](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/R._Buckminster_Fuller "R. Buckminster Fuller") , first published in 1969, following an address with a similar title given to the 50th annual convention of the American Planners Association in the Shoreham Hotel, Washington D.C., on 16 October 1967. [[ 1 ]]()

The book relates Earth to a spaceship flying through space.
